role: Director, Natural Resource Development Board / Department of Business and Economic Development, Illinois
stance_basis: letter explicitly states no adverse comment on the project
summary: Ray C. Dickerson, as Chairman of the Natural Resource Development Board / Department of Business and Economic Development, Illinois, submitted a letter on May 2, 1972 stating that the Board reviewed the Environmental Impact Statements for several highway projects, including FA Route 23 (US 30) Section 22-23-12-R in Cook County, and had no adverse comment to make. His response is purely neutral, neither supporting nor opposing the project.
complaint_summary: Dickerson states on behalf of the Natural Resource Development Board that it has reviewed the Environmental Impact Statements for several highway projects including FA Route 23 (US 30) Section 22-23-12-R, Cook County, and has no adverse comment.

statement.text:
The Natural Resource Development Board has reviewed the Environmental Impact Statements for the following highway projects and has no adverse comment to make thereon:
(a) 1-55 Rest Area  Will County
(b) FA Route 23 Section 110-1, Ogle County
(c) FA Route 23 (US 30) Section 22-23-12-R, Cook County
Sincerely,
Ray C. Dickerson
